findings.description: Dense v3 reverse-edge loops, bridges and route/border contacts prevent reliable independent tracing; no evidence proves all 14 bridges or long detours are forced.
Checks flag six ambiguous label owners across v1–v3; capture contains sibling lanes two cells apart and crowded repeated labels. Exact flagged identities are not recorded.
ECMP and arrowheads overwrite the rack-leaf region title in the target dump and live pane; checker only tests edge labels against routes.
Multiple declared group rectangles collapse into detached empty slivers; v3 rack-leaf wraps its members but its title is interrupted.

Raw candidate exit codes and independently identified stderr, preflight raw close/status evidence, and an actual 77x47 live half-pane capture are missing. Pinned direct dumps and final check exits exist.
Family classification is appropriate, but dense fabric recipe does not produce independently traceable, unambiguous links in the capture.
